title: An oral history of Bank Python (2021)
summary: An in-depth exploration of how Python was adapted and restricted for use in banking environments, particularly examining the evolution of 'Bank Python' - a constrained version of Python used in conservative financial institutions for better stability and security.
problem_solved: How financial institutions adapted Python's flexibility into a more controlled, enterprise-safe language suitable for mission-critical trading and banking systems.
why_valuable: Documents an important chapter in Python's enterprise adoption, showing how practical constraints in conservative industries shaped language usage patterns that influenced modern DevOps and security practices.
